summary: Add a fan relationship between a user and an artist.
description: Allows the user identified by `userid` (via a valid `access_token`) to become a fan of the artist identified by `artist_id`. If the artist does not exist the call succeeds silently and no fan relationship is created. Requires both `client_id` and `access_token`. Optional `format` and `fullcount` parameters control response formatting and pagination metadata.

requestBody.name: client_id
requestBody.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

requestBody.name: fullcount
requestBody.description: If true, includes the total possible result count in the header (performance impact).

requestBody.name: access_token
requestBody.description: A valid OAuth2 access token with the 'music' scope.

requestBody.name: artist_id
requestBody.description: Identifier of the artist to be followed.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Meta information about the request, including status and result count.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Empty array; fan relationship is created server‑side without returning data.

notes: If the specified artist does not exist, the API returns a successful response with an empty results array.
`client_id` is required even when an `access_token` is provided.
`fullcount` can affect performance and is not available on all heavy methods.
